item.title: Route 61 Closed for Tractor Trailer Rollover in Southern Schuylkill County
item.description: Route 61 is closed in both directions near Orwigsburg following a crash Friday afternoon.The incident occurred just after 3:30 p.m. near the intersection of Route 61 and South Liberty Street in South Manheim Township.According to initial reports, a truck rolled onto its side, blocking both lanes of traffic and forcing a full roadway closure.Motorists are being detoured through Orwigsburg while crews work to clear the scene. There is no word on injuries at this time.

item.title: Extreme Cold Warning Issued for Schuylkill County; Wind Chills Could Reach 20 Below Zero This Weekend
item.description: Schuylkill County residents should prepare for dangerously cold conditions this weekend as the National Weather Service has issued an Extreme Cold Warning along with a Wind Advisory. The warning is in effect from 4 a.m. Saturday through 10 a.m. Sunday, with wind chills expected to drop as low as 20 degrees below zero. item.title: North Schuylkill Tops Marian Catholic in Schuylkill League Quarterfinal at Martz Hall
item.description: The road to a Schuylkill League championship started Saturday afternoon at Martz Hall, “The Mecca”, as the North Schuylkill Lady Spartans used steady defense to defeat Marian Catholic, 49-31, in the league girls basketball quarterfinals.
